label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y abridor de asno redimirás con cordero, y si no redimirás, le romperás la nuca; todo primogénito de tus hijos redimirás, y no se verán mis faces vacíos.
spanish: Y abridor de asno redimirás con un animal del rebaño, y si no redimirás, le romperás la nuca; todo primogénito de tus hijos redimirás, y no se verán vacíos mis faces.
grammarChanges: Moved 'vacíos' to follow the verb directly ('no se verán vacíos mis faces') so רֵיקָם reads as the manner of the niphal being-seen, not as a property adjective sitting on 'mis faces'.

Replaced 'cordero' with 'un animal del rebaño' (adding the article Spanish requires for the singular count noun) so שֶׂה keeps its common-gender flock-animal sense instead of narrowing to a young male sheep.
readerNote: Chose word order placing 'vacíos' next to the verb (manner) rather than next to 'mis faces' (property), and widened 'cordero' to 'un animal del rebaño' to match שֶׂה's common-gender range.
